title: dashboard: Alert comparison crashes on non-numeric SenML values
description:
In python/src/lichen/dashboard/app.py lines 250-265, the alert comparison code uses raw SenML values without type checking. If a metric record has a non-numeric 'v' field (string, bool, list, dict), the comparison 'val >= thresholds["crit"]' raises TypeError.

The float crash fix at lines 240-246 only protects history tracking (with try/except around float()). The alert comparison is a separate code path that lacks the same protection.

Fix: Add isinstance(val, (int, float)) check before alert comparisons, or wrap in try/except TypeError.
